name: The Crown Prince's Pegasus
source:
Toyosatomimi no Miko has always wondered what has become of her legendary horse, Kurokoma. What would a reunion entail...? Would Saki still recognize her?
Would Saki still love her even if she wasn't Prince Shoutoku anymore...?

[From [url=https://sumatraguard.itch.io/the-crown-princes-pegasus]itch.io[/url]]
